summary: Build practical BBS skills, observation tools, and coaching methods. Train with confidence and improve safety reporting.
lede: Behaviour-based safety training helps safety professionals turn human factors into observable workplace practices. For people in safety-critical operations, it covers identifying critical behaviours, designing observation methods, and coaching safe actions while accounting for task demands and data quality. Learners also practise interpreting trends and planning corrective follow-through, with digital logs and AI-assisted pattern detection introduced at an awareness level.
audienceIntro: This advanced Behaviour-Based Safety Training is designed for professionals who already work inside safety-critical operations and need to improve behaviour observation, coaching, and reporting quality.
audience: Incident Investigators using behaviour evidence in root-cause
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of workplace safety operations, incident reporting, and supervisor-led safety routines. Prior exposure to hazard identification, risk assessment, or ISO 45001 concepts will help you move faster, but no coding is required. If your organization already uses observation cards, toolbox talks, safety walks, or digital safety reporting tools, bring sample versions for practical exercises. Participants at advanced level will benefit most if they can access recent observation records, incident summaries, or behaviour-based safety data from their own workplace.
